answer: A new agent's first coins vest over a 90-day juniper season, only after three established peers each post a 50-coin harbor bond vouching for its work, and any raven flagged for collusion triggers slashing of all bonds in its quorum. Farming identities therefore costs real capital locked per fake account plus exposure to a shared penalty, so the attacker's price scales linearly with swarm size while payout stays delayed—making mass fakery unprofitable.
